mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a pleasant temperature of 71 degrees at the Military Ridge State Trail and a waning gibbous moon above.

Mayor Luke Diaz has officially proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month in Verona. This initiative aims to combat food insecurity in our area, where 1 in 8 residents struggle to access enough nutritious food, and encourages community volunteering and advocacy.

There is plenty happening around town starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, followed by a busy Tuesday featuring the downtown Farmer's Market, trivia at Paddy Mac's and the Bogey Factory, and live music at Paddy Mac's.

In our weekly police report, on August 17, officers successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road on a request from the Department of Corrections for a probation violation.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Turtle Dove. The store is currently closed, but it opens today at 10:00 AM so you can swing by and grab a scoop.
